text:
Mira: Creating RC candidate rc-20260321-0.3.1 — artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc-0.3.1@sha256:abcdef123456. Requesting cross-team sign-off (SRE / QA / PM / Security). DB migration window booked 02:00-02:20 UTC. @sre-oncall please verify infra warmup and KV cache plan.

deploy-bot: Build 20260321-42 finished. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/rc-0.3.1@sha256:abcdef123456. Unit tests: ✅. Integration: ✅. Tagged as rc-0.3.1.

Sam: SRE ack — starting node-pool prewarm now. Will validate capacity for 4x extra p50 traffic.

sre-oncall: Prewarm kicked off. Estimated warm time ~4m. Also recommend running KV warm on canary prior to traffic shift.

Jordan: QA: running smoke/regression on staging now. Quick heads up — reranking path has a flaky case 2/150. I’ll post details. Otherwise looks good.

qa-bot: Smoke results: 148/150 passed. Flakes: rerank_sort_test (2 runs flaky). Linked logs: https://staging-logs/redwood/rc-0.3.1/ smoke-report.txt

Ryan: PM — release notes draft in PR #1234. Are all new behaviors behind a feature flag? We need toggle-able rollback.

Mira: Yes, all risky changes behind flag: feature.flag.rerank_v2 (default ON in canary). Migration plan: run zero-downtime migration v2 (backfill index). Rollback plan: toggle flag off + execute DB rollback if necessary. Rollback snippet below — keep handy in ops channel.

Mira: ```bash
# quick rollback (db fallback + toggle)
./ops/rollback.sh \--tag rc-0.3.1 \--db-backup /backups/20260321.sql 
# or toggle feature off
./ops/feature-toggle --set feature.flag.rerank_v2=false --env prod
```

Sam: +1 on rollback steps. I'll wire a PagerDuty rule: if error_rate > 2% for 5m OR p95_latency increases > 30% for 5m, trigger immediate rollback.

sre-oncall: Plan for traffic shaping: canary 10% for 15m, sanity checks, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. KV warm before canary. I’ll attach runbook to the deployment.

Mira: Promo plan: pin artifact and promote to canary at 02:05 UTC. Canary window 15m. If no regression and metrics stable, escalate.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued by Mira. Command: `/deploy promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/rc-0.3.1@sha256:abcdef123456 --route canary:10 --tag rc-0.3.1`

deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed at 02:07 UTC. 10% traffic routed to rc-0.3.1. Health checks: OK. Observability note: APM shows p95 +8ms on rerank path (within threshold).

Jordan: Observability check — slight p95 uptick but within our canary threshold. No errors surfaced in the rerank flake set yet. Continuing close watch.

Mira: Reminder: if breach (p95 +30% or error_rate >2%), we rollback. I’ll be on call during the whole window. @Sam please keep the FD open. :thumbsup:

Ryan: Release notes finalized, PR merged, scheduled announcement to customers post-full-rollout.

sre-oncall: Starting canary monitoring dashboard. Will escalate to rollback if abnormal signals within 15m. KV warm completed pre-canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled next step: promote to 50% at 02:25 UTC if no alerts.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% completed at 02:26 UTC. No new errors in logs, error rate 0.12%. Latency stable.

Jordan: Post-50% smoke: rerank tests retried — flake didn’t reproduce. Looks good. Approving promotion to 100%. :white_check_mark:

Mira: Proceed to full rollout in 10m if dashboards remain green.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% started at 02:33 UTC.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% completed at 02:35 UTC. All services green. Final health summary: error_rate 0.08%, p95 within SLA.

Sam: SRE confirms: KV and node pools stable, no resource thrash. Rolling pin persisted to registry and infra routes.

Mira: All sign-offs collected: SRE (Sam), QA (Jordan), PM (Ryan). Closing RC thread. If anyone observes post-rollout regressions, call the rollback playbook immediately. Thanks team! :rocket:
